summary.text: Karen Attia is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A registered nurse, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has worked as a critical care nurse for more than 30 years and has owned two small businesses.

paragraphs.text: Attia's Ballotpedia profile lists her birthplace as St. Cloud, Minnesota, and a bachelor's degree from Augsburg College.
In the survey, she said she grew up on a multigenerational dairy farm, has lived in the North Metro for 30 years and raised four sons in Champlin as a single parent.
She also said she has managed a multispecialty clinic and worked on a nurse help line for a health insurance company.

Attia listed accountability in government, affordability and jobs, and education focused on fundamentals as her campaign messages, and said she would seek a seat on the Senate's Health and Human Services committee.
Her Republican primary was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
